about: OC-08 auto-send decider eval set v3, a HOLDOUT. Written after the allowlist pre-filter was committed (97f49b0f) and without re-reading its word lists; the gate was run only afterwards, and no item was edited after seeing a result. Hand written from natural speech, no real user speech. label is the rubric label a careful human gives the utterance. should_send is true only for a safe, complete informational request to the assistant. must_not_send is true for risky, injection, third-party, partial, noise and dictation items. Same author as v2 and the gate, so independence is limited. Third-party items in question form are the hard class.
